name: Imlah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Ahab answers that there is one man, Micaiah the son of Imlah, but he hates him because Micaiah does not prophesy good concerning him, but evil. Jehoshaphat rebukes him, saying, let not the king say so.

note.label: 1 Kings 22: A Lying Spirit and the Fall of Ahab

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org

cases.name: Micaiah the son of Imlah
cases.charge: As the Lord liveth, what the Lord saith unto me, that will I speak: against four hundred prophets, two kings, a slap, and a prison
